Instantiate {BoardId} and child index placeholders from HWDB/deployment records; do not hand-maintain 192+ board copies.
Every row states whether it is current OPC-UA, current Protobuf, locally readable, required production work, or excluded from routine DCS.

DAQ and SC are authenticated clients of one neutral PDS OPC-UA gateway. The gateway alone maintains the DAPHNE Protobuf/ZMQ backend, serializes board mutations, and enforces the Control Owner policy; SC never receives or executes a DAQ configuration handoff.

DAQ owns timing, AFE/channel operating values, triggers, spy buffers, packetization and readout. SC owns power/bias enable, rails, services, firmware lifecycle, network, fans, equipment health and safe state. Column AB is normative.

The OPC-UA gateway authorizes every typed method against the exported workbook policy and serializes accepted board mutations; the board service retains independent range/safety validation. All writes require authenticated authority, state/permit guards, bounded execution, audit, and verified readback/postcondition.
No numeric alarm/interlock thresholds are guessed. PDS/SC/DPS must fill reviewed limits and actions before approval.

The NP02 Compatibility sheet transcribes a supplied 2025 color matrix as historical admission evidence. Red means an activation pair is incompatible; green does not bypass other guards; orange 'probably compatible' remains unresolved and is not a permit. The source is not a production cause-and-effect specification.
